name: Santos
scopeLimits: Official SIGSantos GeoServer WFS qualification covered 13 aligned 0.001° cells and four adjacent pans around the unchanged WUP locator. All 13 raw collection counts matched; 419 cell-level rows represented 257 distinct GeoServer FIDs and 171 distinct native `lote` strings. The source has 40 repeated-lote groups (126 rows involved), and the generic adapter forced-page test failed because it sorts by non-unique `lote` and repeated FIDs across offsets. A direct WFS 2.0.0 count/startIndex test with sortBy omitted completed all 62 rows across 21 three-row pages; the existing adapter cannot express that request contract. Independent GEOS EPSG:32723 QA used all 257 distinct raw features from the bounded union: all valid, 229 equal-geometry pairs, 341 positive-area overlap pairs above 0.01 m², zero operation errors; union valid. This remains local bounded-source evidence, not citywide coverage or runtime qualification. The exact WUP parcel `lotes.20499` / `55044022` is present in the sample and matches the original exact-point WFS geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The City of Santos provides SIGSantos and public Santos Mapeada. The official WFS `santos:lotes` layer is explicitly “Lotes Oficiais”; this point query is local evidence only and does not establish whole-city completeness.
technicalBlocker: The existing generic WFS adapter hardcodes sortBy=native id. `lote` is not unique in the official `santos:lotes` layer: the 13-cell union contains 171 distinct native values across 257 distinct WFS FIDs, including 40 repeated-lote groups. With pageSize=3, sorted offset pages repeated FIDs and the adapter correctly rejected the response. Direct WFS 2.0.0 count/startIndex paging with sortBy omitted completed 62/62 unique FIDs, so the source supports paging but the current adapter cannot express the safe stable default-order contract. Do not enable runtime until a unique sortable source identity or verified no-sort paging option is supported.
remainingUncertainty: The 13-cell local footprint is not whole-city completeness. The source contains repeated native lote values across distinct GeoServer FIDs; while tested copies had topologically identical geometries, their underlying cadastral row semantics and revision continuity remain unverified. City boundary coverage, attribution/license terms, publication freshness, legal-title meaning, and a runtime-safe pagination/identity contract remain unverified.
nextStep: Root review; any runtime onboarding should first complete a bounded city-level qualification and confirm source attribution/terms.
